recognize_zh: 肋膜液抹片中可見巨大多核細胞與雙核／三核細胞，細胞質深藍嗜鹼性、核仁明顯，並有核偏位的非典型漿細胞，符合多發性骨髓瘤侵犯肋膜的異常巨大漿細胞。
features: Giant multinucleated cell (top) with several nuclei and deeply basophilic cytoplasm
Multinucleated (trinucleate) atypical plasma cell with round nuclei, fine chromatin, and distinct nucleoli (right)
Plasma cell with eccentric nucleus and deep blue cytoplasm containing a dense round inclusion with a pale halo (bottom)
Small cells with dense nuclei and background pink-purple proteinaceous material at left
Scattered degenerating cells and debris; red cells scant
describe_en: Cytospin preparation of pleural fluid shows markedly atypical plasma cells, including a giant multinucleated form and a trinucleate cell with prominent nucleoli, both with deeply basophilic cytoplasm. An additional plasma cell with an eccentric nucleus contains a dense round cytoplasmic inclusion of uncertain nature, possibly phagocytosed material or an immunoglobulin inclusion. The background contains proteinaceous material, small lymphoid or degenerating cells, and debris. In a patient with multiple myeloma, findings are consistent with myelomatous pleural effusion; flow cytometry with light chain restriction or CD138 immunocytochemistry is recommended for confirmation.

ddx.vs: Mesothelial cells show central nuclei, dense perinuclear and pale peripheral cytoplasm with surface blebs, and intercellular windows, and are calretinin/WT1 positive and CD138 light-chain negative.
Adenocarcinoma cells form cohesive three-dimensional clusters with vacuolated cytoplasm and are cytokeratin/claudin-4 positive.

ddx.dx: Plasmablastic or anaplastic large cell lymphoma
ddx.vs: These contain large blastic cells without a known myeloma history; PBL is often EBER positive and ALCL is CD30 positive with hallmark kidney-shaped nuclei.
Macrophages have abundant pale vacuolated cytoplasm with bean-shaped nuclei rather than deeply basophilic cytoplasm with eccentric nuclei and hof.
